role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 在阴影中微微振翅，也许这就是敌人眼中的邪影芳灵，她躲避追击，操控狡猾的仙灵法术控制敌人的行动。召唤远比书上的魔法更为古老的力量，她将敌人束缚在原地，再将仙灵之境的所有怒火和恐怖全数释放。
hero_summary_en: A slight flutter from the shadows may be all an enemy sees of Dark Willow, as she eludes pursuit and controls her foe's movements with cunning fae tricks. Calling upon powers far more ancient than any scholarly magic, she binds enemies in place before unleashing the full wrath and terror of the fae realm upon them.

abilities.name: dark_willow_bramble_maze
abilities.description_zh: %initial_creation_delay%秒后邪影芳灵在目标区域创造出%placement_range%范围的迷宫，迷宫拥有%placement_count%棵荆棘。进入荆棘的敌人将被缠绕，并且持续受到伤害。迷宫持续%placement_duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Dark Willow creates a %placement_range% AoE maze of %placement_count% brambles that grow in the target area after %initial_creation_delay% seconds. Enemies that walk into a bramble are rooted and take damage over time. Lasts %placement_duration% seconds.
notes_zh: 缠绕无法打断持续施法。
notes_en: Does not interrupt channeling spells upon rooting.

abilities.name: dark_willow_shadow_realm
abilities.description_zh: 邪影芳灵遁入暗影之境，无法成为攻击或技能的目标。她的下次攻击具有%attack_range_bonus%额外攻击距离，并且造成额外魔法伤害，暗影之境技能也会随之结束。在暗影中时间越长，伤害越高。在暗影之境内的时间超过%max_damage_duration%秒将达到最高伤害。
abilities.description_en: Dark Willow recedes into the shadows, becoming untargetable.  Her next attack has %attack_range_bonus% bonus attack range and deals bonus magic damage, and will end Shadow Realm. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm, the maximum being reached after %max_damage_duration% seconds.
notes_zh: 需要视野的技能无法作用于暗影之境中的邪影芳灵。
notes_en: Spells which require vision cannot affect Dark Willow in the Shadow Realm.

scepter_loc.en: Attacking no longer takes Dark Willow out of Shadow Realm. Each attack still has bonus damage based on the duration of the buff.
scepter_loc.zh: 发动普通攻击不再使邪影芳灵脱离暗影之境。持续时间内每次攻击都带有额外伤害。

facet_text_en: While in Shadow Realm, Dark Willow emits a %aura_radius% radius aura that increases damage that she deals to enemies in its area of effect by up to %aura_damage_pct%%%. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm.
facet_text_zh: 处于暗影之境时，邪影芳灵会散发出一个%aura_radius%范围的光环，使她对范围内的敌人造成的伤害增加，最高为%aura_damage_pct%%%。根据她在暗影之境内停留的时间，造成的伤害会随之增加。

abilities.name: dark_willow_cursed_crown
abilities.description_zh: 邪影芳灵授予敌人一顶被诅咒的古老仙灵王冠。经过一定延迟后，目标和周围的所有敌人都会被眩晕。
abilities.description_en: Dark Willow casts an ancient fae curse on the target. After a delay, the target and nearby enemies are stunned.

shard_loc.en: Cursed Crown creates %shard_bramble_amount% brambles in a %shard_spawn_radius% radius around the target after the counter ends. Triggers even upon dispel. Cursed Crown cooldown reduced by 1.5 seconds.
shard_loc.zh: 诅咒王冠在倒计时结束时会围绕目标在%shard_spawn_radius%范围内产生%shard_bramble_amount%朵荆棘。即使效果被驱散也会触发。诅咒王冠的冷却时间减少1.5秒。

facet_text_en: While ticking, Cursed Crown accumulates %accumulated_damage_pct%%% of all damage dealt by Dark Willow and %accumulated_damage_pct_ally%%% of attack damage dealt by allied heroes. When the counter ends, the accumulated damage is dealt again as magical damage to the whole area. This triggers even upon dispel with Aghanim's Shard.
facet_text_zh: 倒计时期间诅咒王冠会累计邪影芳灵对目标造成所有伤害的%accumulated_damage_pct%%%，还有友方英雄对其造成攻击伤害的%accumulated_damage_pct_ally%%%。倒计时结束时，累计的伤害会作为魔法伤害施加给整个区域。拥有阿哈利姆魔晶后，可以在技能被驱散时触发。

abilities.name: dark_willow_bedlam
abilities.description_zh: 邪影芳灵放出她的精灵宠物在持续时间内围绕自身飞行，快速攻击周围敌人。恐吓生效期间不能使用作祟。
abilities.description_en: Dark Willow sends her pet wisp to roam around herself for the duration, rapidly attacking nearby enemies.  Bedlam cannot be used while Terrorize is active.

abilities.name: dark_willow_pixie_dust
abilities.description_zh: 邪影芳灵获得额外%hp_regen_amp%%%生命恢复和魔法恢复，而她无法作为目标或无敌时将提升至%hp_regen_amp_out_of_world%%%。
abilities.description_en: Dark Willow gains %hp_regen_amp%%% bonus Health and Mana Regeneration, increased to %hp_regen_amp_out_of_world%%% while she is untargetable or invulnerable.

abilities.name: dark_willow_terrorize
abilities.description_zh: 邪影芳灵放出她的精灵宠物恐吓她的敌人。经过一定延迟后，目标区域内所有敌人变得害怕，朝自己的泉水狂奔。作祟开启期间不能使用恐吓。
abilities.description_en: Dark Willow releases her pet wisp to terrorize her enemies. After a short delay, all enemies in the target area become fearful and run toward their home fountain. Terrorize cannot be used while Bedlam is active.
notes_zh: 恐吓提供受作用单位的视野。
notes_en: Terrorize provides vision on affected units.
